_source.chunkText:
User encountered INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE error after completing the restore process.

_source.description: Bare Metal Recovery(BMR) of Windows 2022 server using the VSR23 created image completes but the server fails to boot - ' Inaccessible boot device '
_source.chunkText:
Bare metal restore of Windows 2022 server using the VSR23 created image/SRD 23- Inaccessible boot device '
Case Resolution Summary : ** Booted from the Symantec Recovery Disk (SRD) ** From the main SRD menu, select Analyze ** Selected Open Command Shell Window ** Typed DISKPART and press enter ** Typed LIST DISK and press enter (the disks that have been detected by the recovery environment (WindowsPE) will now be listed) ** Selected the disk that you want to restore to by typing SELECT DISK # (i.e. SELECT DISK 0) ** Cleaned the disk by typing CLEAN and pressing enter ** Typed EXIT and press enter to leave DISKPART The disk is now ready for SSR to restore to. Restoring UEFI Based Image ** From the main SRD menu, select 'Recover My Computer' ** Clicked Next ** From the View recovery points by menu, select 'Filename' ** Browsed and locate the recent recovery point (.v2i) file for the 'Recovery Partition ' ** Clicked Next ** If you are prompted to initialize the disk, select the check-box and click OK . ** Once the disk has been initialized, you will be presented with the Drives to Recover screen. ** Now click the 'Edit' option and now in the edit page make sure the following options are selected, 1. Restore Original Disk Signature . ** Now proceeded with the restore process of System Reserved drive and at the final step make sure that the 'Reboot System' is unchecked. ** From the main SRD menu, select 'Recover My Computer' ** Clicked Next ** From the View recovery points by menu, select 'Filename' ** Browsed and locate the recent recovery point (.v2i) file for the 'System Partition ' ** Clicked Next ** If you are prompted to initialize the disk, select the check-box and click OK . ** Once the disk has been initialized, you will be presented with the Drives to Recover screen. ** Now clicked the 'Edit' option and now in the edit page make sure the following options are selected, 1. Restore Original Disk Signature . ** Go went to the main SRD menu, select 'Recover My Computer' ** Clicked Next ** From the View recovery points by menu, select 'Filename' ** Browsed and locate the recent recovery point (.v2i) file for the 'C drive' ** Clicked Next ** If you are prompted to initialize the disk, select the check-box and click OK . At this point an error is raised stating the Recovery point might be corruted due to bad sectors in the source disk . Informed that may be bad sectors observed while the image was created and hence the above error . Patrick is not sure with the exact reason for this server to crash as its used by one of his client . One fine day a power failure happened due to which the server failed to boot post that . So not sure if corruption or bad sectors in the internal HDD was the cause for the same. However looking at the error reported while restoring the C:\ drive the error indicates something in the lines of HDD bad sectors due to which the VSR recovery points for C drive could have gone corrupted . Patrick agreed the same however he would like to proceed with the restore so continued the same . ** Once the disk has been initialized, it presented the Drives to Recover screen. ** Now clicked the 'Edit' option and now in the edit page make sure the following options are selected, 1. Restore Original Disk Signature . Completed the restore and restarted the server . No boot and went to repair options . Tried the repair with the OS disk . x:\sources\recovery\Startrep.exe Its in progress . In case if it fails advised to run the below and update status which he agreed. x:\sources>bootrec /fixboot x:\sources>bootrec /rebuildbcd x:\sources>bootrec /scanos However the boot failed due to corruption in recovery point , So installed a fresh windows copy and restored file/folder using VSR .
_source.recordTitle: Bare Metal Recovery(BMR) of Windows 2022 server using the VSR23 created image completes but the server fails to boot - ' Inaccessible boot device '
